newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine Sept producer price rise grows to 1 pct.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine Sept producer price rise grows to 1 pct.

text.p: The monthly rise in Ukraine's producer prices climbed to one percent in September from 0.4 percent in August, the Statistics Ministry said on Friday.
UKRAINE PRODUCER PRICES Sept 96 Aug 96 Sept 95
Producer prices have risen 14.7 percent for the first nine months of this year, compared to 134.7 percent for the same period last year.
The highest price rises so far this year were 24.3 percent for machine parts, 22.3 percent for building materials and a 21.7-percent rise for paper products.
